regulation.description: In order to comply with increasing global regulations, Apple is asking all app developers to declare if an app offers location sharing features, dating, or romantic interactions of any kind. Apps with location sharing features are subject to age gating Apple started enforcing self-reporting of age-rating details in 2025 to get ahead of more specific age gating regulations. The system is being tweaked over time, and new changes have been revealed. In a developer news post first spotted by MacRumo

crypto.title: Tether holds 150,000 bitcoin worth $11.5 billion, CEO Paolo Ardoino says
crypto.description: Ardoino didn’t say where the extra coins sit. Holdings outside USDT reserves, such as Tether’s investments, wouldn’t appear in the report.

crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin faces fifth weekly loss as midterm elections weigh on markets
crypto.description: A fifth straight weekly decline would mark bitcoin’s joint third-longest losing streak, as oil rebounds and Apple’s margin warning adds to investor caution ahead of the U.S. midterms.
